name: quickdraw_bitmap
description: QuickDraw Bitmap is a large collection of 28x28 binary (bitmap) images of human-drawn sketches across hundreds of object categories. The benchmark measures a model's ability to recognize and classify crude, highly variable hand-drawn sketches under realistic intra-class variation and noise. It is commonly used for image classification, few-shot learning, and robustness experiments on sketch-like inputs.
reputation: Widely used and well-known dataset for sketch recognition with broad adoption in research, education, and model prototyping.
